description: This Java class 'TensorImageUtils' provides utility functions for converting Android Bitmap and Image objects into PyTorch Tensors, with support for normalization, cropping, rotation, and different memory formats. It is part of the 'org.pytorch.torchvision' package and specifically tailored for image preprocessing in mobile applications using PyTorch.

classes.name: TensorImageUtils
classes.description: Utility class for converting Bitmap and Image objects to Torch Tensors with normalization, cropping, and rotation support.

methods.name: bitmapToFloat32Tensor
methods.description: Creates a Tensor from a Bitmap with optional normalization and specified memory format.

methods.name: imageYUV420CenterCropToFloat32Tensor
methods.description: Creates a Tensor from an Image in YUV420_888 format with optional rotation, cropping, normalization, and specified memory format.
